2  ORDER

The learned Government Pleader, on instructions, submits that pursuant to the private complaint filed by the petitioners, Crime No.464/2022 was registered by the Station House Officer of the Palarivattom Police Station on 4.5.2022.

Consequent to the investigation, a final report has been filed before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IX, Ernakulam, on 16.1.2023 as against the respondents 5 and 6 for the offences under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

Therefore, the petitioners' grievance stands redressed.
The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners prays time to get instructions.
